## Purpose

This page summarizes the standalone technical scope of M11 - Code Summarization.

## Technical Scope

- Reported overall evaluation score: 149/200 (74.5 percent)
- Better outcomes on English and Spanish than on German in provided validation
- Known failure patterns include verbose outputs and occasional code echoing instead of summaries
- Max context length in current setup: 4096 tokens
- Module intended for experimentation before production hardening

## Run Guidance

Use OpenAI-compatible completion endpoint configured for Villanova-2B deployment

## Expected Outcome

A reproducible execution path suitable for technical validation, demonstrations, and staged integration into platform workflows.
